title: Treaty of Teusina
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Teusina", at revision 1340762372, opens: "The Treaty of Teusina was concluded by Russian diplomats under the boyar Afanasiy Pushkin and ambassadors of the Swedish king at the village of Tyavzino in Ingria on 18 May 1595 to end the Russo-Swedish War (1590–1595)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q690861, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1595 peace treaty". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
